4300.meaning1: not hearsay; not mere talk; not oral tradition
4300.meaning2: not based on hearsay, known by oneself

examples.text: kittayissāmi te dhammaṃ, diṭṭhe dhamme anītihaṃ, yaṃ viditvā sato caraṃ, tare loke visattikaṃ.
abhibhū hi so anabhibhūto, sakkhidhammam'anītiham'adassī, tasmā hi tassa bhagavato sāsane, appamatto sadā namassam'anusikkhe'ti.

4302.meaning1: unobstructive; not hindering; not blocking; free from obstacles

examples.text: satt'ime, brāhmaṇa, bojjh'aṅgā anāvaraṇā anīvaraṇā cetaso anupakkilesā bhāvitā bahulīkatā vijjāvimutti-phalasacchikiriyāya saṃvattanti. katame satta?
bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, kummo kacchapo sāy'anhasamayaṃ anunadītīre gocarapasuto ahosi. siṅgālopi kho, bhikkhave, sāy'anhasamayaṃ anunadītīre gocarapasuto ahosi.

puthulato pana diyaḍḍharatanaṃ dvīsu passesu ratanamatta-anucaṅkamaṃ dīghato saṭṭhihatthaṃ mudutalaṃ sama-vippakiṇṇa-vālukaṃ caṅkamaṃ vaṭṭati cetiyagirimhi dīpappasādaka-mahindattherassa caṅkamanaṃ viya, tādisaṃ taṃ ahosi.
anvaddhamāsan'ti anuposathikaṃ.
idān'eva kho ahaṃ ājānāmi, ayam'pi kira dhammo, sutt'āgato suttapariyāpanno, anuaddhamāsaṃ uddesaṃ āgacchatī'ti

4307.meaning1: more; further; following; after; behind; along

examples.text: yato kho, ānanda, bhikkhu ime aṭṭha vimokkhe anulomam'pi samāpajjati, paṭilomam'pi samāpajjati, anulomapaṭilomam'pi samāpajjati, yatth'icchakaṃ yadicchakaṃ yāvat'icchakaṃ samāpajjati'pi vuṭṭhāti'pi.

4309.meaning2: lineage, succession; what follows, (logical) connection, inference, consequence

4312.meaning2: leads or brings after oneself; incurs

examples.text: paradhammikānam'pi na santaseyya, disvā'pi tesaṃ bahubheravāni, ath'āparāni abhisambhaveyya, parissayāni kusala-anuesī.
kuso yathā duggahito, hattham'eva-anukantati, sāmaññaṃ dupparāmaṭṭhaṃ, nirayāy'upakaḍḍhati.

4323.meaning1: in the sense of cutting into

examples.text: brahmā'ti mātāpitaro, pubb'ācariyā'ti vuccare, āhuneyyā ca puttānaṃ, pajāya anukampakā.
yaṃ kho, bhikkhu, satthārā karaṇīyaṃ sāvakānaṃ hit'esinā anukampakena anukampaṃ upādāya, kataṃ vo taṃ mayā.

4327.commentary: (MNa) pacchimaṃ janataṃ tathāgato anukampatī'ti idaṃ thero vuttesu kāraṇesu tatiyaṃ kāraṇaṃ sandhāy'āha.

examples.text: pacchimaṃ janataṃ tathāgato anukampatī'ti.

4328.commentary: (MNt) eten'eva pacchimajanataṃ anukampanato'ti idam'pi kāraṇaṃ ekadesena saṃvaṇṇitan'ti daṭṭhabbaṃ.

examples.text: dasame catūhi paccayehi anukampanaṃ āmis'ānukampā, dhammena anukampanaṃ dhamm'ānukampā'ti.
kasmā pan'ettha bhagavā sayaṃ agamāsī'ti? tayo kulaputtā sāmaggirasaṃ anubhavantā viharanti, tesaṃ paggaṇhanato, pacchimajanataṃ anukampanato dhammagarubhāvato ca.

4329.commentary: (ANa) anukampantā'ti ko ajja amhehi anuggahetabbo, kassa deyyadhammaṃ vā paṭiggaṇheyyāma, dhammaṃ vā deseyyāmā'ti evaṃ cittena anukampamānā.

examples.text: ye te, bhikkhave, loke santo sappurisā te saddhaññ'eva paṭhamaṃ anukampantā anukampan'ti, no tathā assaddhaṃ, saddhaññ'eva paṭhamaṃ upasaṅkamantā upasaṅkamanti, no tathā assaddhaṃ
tassa me sahāyo suhadayo, saddho āsi upāsako, so'pi maṃ anukampanto, nivāresi punappunaṃ.

4330.commentary: (ANa) pacchimañ'ca janataṃ anukampamāno'ti pacchime mama sāvake anukampanto.

examples.text: dv'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, atthavase sampassamāno araññavanapatthāni pantāni sen'āsanāni paṭisevāmi. katame dve? attano ca diṭṭhadhammasukhavihāraṃ sampassamāno, pacchimañ'ca janataṃ anukampamāno.

4331.meaning1: having compassion (for); taking pity (on); having concern (for)

4333.commentary: (SNa) anukampaṃ upādāyā'ti anukampaṃ cittena pariggahetvā, paṭiccā'ti'pi vuttaṃ hoti. (ANa) anukampaṃ upādāyā'ti… anukampaṃ paṭicca.

examples.text: evañ'ca vadehi, sādhu kira, bhante, ayyo ānando yena bhikkhun'upassayo yena sā bhikkhunī ten'upasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyā'ti.
satthārā karaṇīyaṃ sāvakānaṃ hit'esinā anukampakena anukampaṃ upādāya

so tasmiṃ purise kāruññaṃ'y'eva upaṭṭhāpeyya, anuddayaṃ'y'eva upaṭṭhāpeyya, anukampaṃ'y'eva upaṭṭhāpeyya, aho vat'āyaṃ puriso labheyya sappāyāni bhojanāni, labheyya sappāyāni bhesajjāni, labheyya patirūpaṃ upaṭṭhākaṃ, labheyya gām'antanāyakaṃ!
yaṃ kho, bhikkhu, satthārā karaṇīyaṃ sāvakānaṃ hit'esinā anukampakena anukampaṃ upādāya, kataṃ vo taṃ mayā.

4335.meaning1: arisen out of compassion; born from concern; (comm) having a compassionate nature

examples.text: atha khv'ettha brāhmaṇā anukampājātikaṃ'y'eva dānaṃ dentī'ti.

4336.meaning1: cared; had compassion; was concerned (for); took pity (on)

examples.text: ubhayena vata maṃ so bhagavā atthena anukampi, diṭṭhadhammikena c'eva atthena samparāyikena cā'ti

4337.grammar: adj, fem nom sg of anukampaka (+dat)

examples.text: atha kho bāhiyassa dārucīriyassa purāṇasālohitā devatā anukampikā atthakāmā bāhiyassa dārucīriyassa cetasā cetoparivitakkam'aññāya yena bāhiyo dārucīriyo ten'upasaṅkami

4338.meaning1: cared (for); taken pity (on); had compassion (for); concerned (for)

examples.text: anukampitarūpā vat'āyaṃ bhotā gotamena pacchimā janatā, yathā taṃ arahatā sammāsambuddhena.

4339.meaning1: who has been compassionately cared for; which has been taken pity on (by)

examples.text: anukampitarūpā vat'āyaṃ bhotā gotamena pacchimā janatā, yathā taṃ arahatā sammāsambuddhena.

4340.meaning1: to care; to take pity; to have compassion

examples.text: yena kenaci vaṇṇena, saṃvāso sakka jāyati, na taṃ arahati sappañño, manasā anukampituṃ.

4341.synonym: anukampaka, anukampikā, anuddaya, kāruṇika, dayāpanna, manasānukampī

examples.text: sabbapāṇabhūtahita-anukampī byāpādapadosā cittaṃ parisodheti
ekam'pi ce pāṇam'aduṭṭhacitto, mettāyati kusalī tena hoti. sabbe ca pāṇe manasa-anukampī, pahūtam'ariyo pakaroti puññaṃ.
iminā'pi aṅgena arahataṃ anukaromi uposatho ca me upavuttho bhavissati
suṇantu dhammaṃ kālenā'ti khaṇe khaṇe khanti-mettā-paṭisaṅkhā-sāraṇīyadhammaṃ suṇantu. tañ'ca anuvidhīyantū'ti tañ'ca dhammaṃ anukarontu pūrentu.

4345.commentary: (DNa) silokam'anukassāmī'ti akkharapadaniyamitaṃ vacanasaṅghātaṃ pavattayissāmi. yattha bhummā tadassitā'ti yesu yesu ṭhānesu bhummā devatā taṃ taṃ nissitā.

examples.text: silokam'anukassāmi, yattha bhummā tadassitā, ye sitā girigabbharaṃ, pahit'attā samāhitā.

4349.commentary: (UDa) ubhayam'etaṃ raj'ānukiṇṇan'ti etaṃ ubhayaṃ pattaṃ pattabbañ'ca rāgaraj'ādīhi anukiṇṇaṃ. sampatte hi vatthukāme anubhavanto rāgarajena vokiṇṇo hoti, tattha pana saṃkiliṭṭhacittassa phale āyatiṃ āpanne domanass'uppattiyā dosarajena vokiṇṇo hoti, ubhay'atthā'pi moharajena vokiṇṇo hoti.

examples.text: yañ'ca pattaṃ yañ'ca pattabbaṃ, ubhayam'etaṃ raja-anukiṇṇaṃ, āturass'ānusikkhato. ye ca sikkhāsārā sīlabbataṃ jīvitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ upaṭṭhānasārā, ayam'eko anto.
duddadaṃ dadamānānaṃ, dukkaraṃ kamma kubbataṃ, asanto na-anukubbanti, sataṃ dhammo duranvayo.
ty'āssa sīlavato sīlaṃ, cāgaṃ sucaritāni ca, passamāna-anukubbanti, attam'atthaṃ vicakkhaṇā.

4352.meaning1: according to tradition; following family custom
4352.commentary: (DNa) anukulayaññānī'ti, amhākaṃ pitupitāmah'ādīhi pavattitānī'ti katvā pacchā duggatapurisehi'pi vaṃsaparam'parāya pavattetabbāni yāgāni, evarūpāni kira sīlavante uddissa nibaddhadānāni tasmiṃ kule daliddā'pi na upacchindanti.

examples.text: yāni kho pana tāni, brāhmaṇa, niccadānāni anukulayaññāni sīlavante pabbajite uddissa diyyanti, ayaṃ kho, brāhmaṇa, yañño imāya tividhāya yaññasampadāya soḷasaparikkhārāya app'aṭṭhataro ca appasamārambhataro ca mahapphalataro ca mah'ānisaṃsataro cā'ti.

4353.meaning1: offering according to family tradition; sacrifice following family custom
4353.commentary: (DNa) anukulayaññānī'ti, amhākaṃ pitupitāmah'ādīhi pavattitānī'ti katvā pacchā duggatapurisehi'pi vaṃsaparam'parāya pavattetabbāni yāgāni, evarūpāni kira sīlavante uddissa nibaddhadānāni tasmiṃ kule daliddā'pi na upacchindanti.

examples.text: yāni kho pana tāni, brāhmaṇa, niccadānāni anukulayaññāni sīlavante pabbajite uddissa diyyanti, ayaṃ kho, brāhmaṇa, yañño imāya tividhāya yaññasampadāya soḷasaparikkhārāya app'aṭṭhataro ca appasamārambhataro ca mahapphalataro ca mah'ānisaṃsataro cā'ti.

4354.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of anukula
4354.meaning1: according to tradition; following family custom
4354.commentary: (SNa) yajanti anukulan'ti anukulesu yajanti, yaṃ niccabhatt'ādi pubbapurisehi paṭṭhapitaṃ, taṃ apar'āparaṃ anupacchinnattā manussā dadantī'ti attho.

examples.text: ye ca yaññā nirārambhā, yajanti anukulaṃ sadā, aj'eḷakā ca gāvo ca, vividhā n'ettha haññare, etaṃ sammaggatā yaññaṃ, upayanti mah'esino.

4355.meaning2: in each family; according to custom

4356.synonym: anucchavi, anucchavika, anuloma, upiya, kappa, kappiya, tajja, tathārūpa, tadanurūpa, paṭirūpa, patirūpa, patirūpaka, patirūpī, pattayutta, yutta, yuttaka, yuttarūpa, sampanna, sāmaggiya, sāruppa
4356.commentary: (CPa) vicaranto anukūlamhī'ti ucchiṭṭhadantakaṭṭhe attano jaṭāsu lagge tassa āgamanagavesanavasena gaṅgāya tīre anuvicaranto.

4357.meaning1: due to an appropriate Dhamma discourse

examples.text: chetvā naddhiṃ varattañ'ca, sandānaṃ sah'anukkamaṃ, ukkhittapalighaṃ buddhaṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.
so tassa nagarassa samantā anupariyāyapathaṃ anukkamati. anupariyāyapathaṃ anukkamamāno na passeyya pākārasandhiṃ vā pākāravivaraṃ vā, antamaso biḷāranikkhamanamattam'pi.
so tassa nagarassa samantā anupariyāyapathaṃ anukkamati. anupariyāyapathaṃ anukkamamāno na passeyya pākārasandhiṃ vā pākāravivaraṃ vā, antamaso biḷāranikkhamanamattam'pi.

4365.meaning1: to make progress; to proceed; to advance
4365.commentary: (SNa) taṃ paṭipadaṃ bhāsitamattena vā savanamattena vā okkamituṃ paṭipajjituṃ na sakkā'ti attho.

examples.text: na y'idaṃ bhāsitamattena, ek'antasavanena vā, anukkamitave sakkā, yāyaṃ paṭipadā daḷhā, yāya dhīrā pamuccanti, jhāyino mārabandhanā.

4366.grammar: ind, adv, instr sg of anukkama
4366.meaning1: successively; sequentially in order; by degrees; progressively; gradually
4366.meaning2: gradually, by degrees, in order, in due course
4366.commentary: (VISMa) anukkamenā'ti atippiyapuggalo piyapuggalo majjhatto verī'ti catūsu koṭṭhāsesu ek'ekasmiṃ kammaṭṭhānaṃ paguṇaṃ, muduṃ, kammaniyañ'ca katvā sesesu upasaṃharaṇ'ānukkamena.

examples.text: evaṃ taṃ puggalaṃ karuṇāyitvā tato paraṃ eten'eva upāyena piyapuggale, tato majjhatte, tato verimhī'ti anukkamena karuṇā pavattetabbā.
uyyānapālo tassa madhumakkhitatiṇesu paluddhabhāvaṃ ñatvā anukkamena attānaṃ dassesi.
seyyathā'pi, brāhmaṇa, udapatto agginā asantatto anukkudhito anussadakajāto. tattha cakkhumā puriso sakaṃ mukhanimittaṃ paccavekkhamāno yathābhūtaṃ pajāneyya passeyya.
yattakā bhikkhū tassa uposathakammassa pattā yuttā anurūpā, sabb'antimena paricchedena cattāro bhikkhū pakatattā, saṅghena anukkhittā, te ca kho hatthapāsaṃ avijahitvā ekasīmayaṃ ṭhitā.
examples.source: VIN PAT PK saṅghuposatha pubbakaraṇādi vidhi

examples.text: anāpatti anukkhitto'ti jānāti, ukkhitto osārito'ti jānāti, ukkhitto taṃ diṭṭhiṃ paṭinissaṭṭho'ti jānāti, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

4369.construction:
na > an + ud + √khip + ta + ka
anukkhitta + ka
4369.commentary: (VINa) ukkhepanīyakammakato ukkhittako nāma, avasesa-catubbidha-tajjanīy'ādi-kammakato anukkhittako nāma. ayañ'hi uposathaṃ vā pavāraṇaṃ vā dhammaparibhogaṃ vā āmisaparibhogaṃ vā na kopeti.

examples.text: ukkhittako puggalo jānitabbo. anukkhittako puggalo jānitabbo. nāsitako puggalo jānitabbo.
anukkhittake vematiko, āpatti dukkaṭassa. anukkhittake anukkhittakasaññī, anāpatti.

4372.meaning2: having not raised up; having not lifted up

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sīlesu paripūrakārī hoti samādhismiṃ paripūrakārī paññāya paripūrakārī. so yāni tāni khudda-anukhuddakāni sikkhāpadāni tāni āpajjati'pi vuṭṭhāti'pi.
kiṃ pan'imehi khudda-anukhuddakehi sikkhāpadehi uddiṭṭhehi, yāva'd'eva kukkuccāya vihesāya vilekhāya saṃvattantī'ti
yaṃ kho me idaṃ kiñci pubbe iminā karajakāyena pāpakammaṃ kataṃ sabbaṃ taṃ idha vedanīyaṃ, na taṃ anugaṃ bhavissatī'ti
tañ'hi tassa sakaṃ hoti, tañ'ca ādāya gacchati, tañ'c'assa anugaṃ hoti, chāyā'va anapāyinī.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso araññe pavane caramāno passeyya purāṇaṃ maggaṃ purāṇ'añjasaṃ pubbakehi manussehi anuyātaṃ. so tam'anugaccheyya.
tam'anugacchanto passeyya purāṇaṃ nagaraṃ purāṇaṃ rājadhāniṃ pubbakehi manussehi ajjhāvuṭṭhaṃ ārāmasampannaṃ vanasampannaṃ pokkharaṇīsampannaṃ uddhāpavantaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ.
yagghe, bhante, jāneyyāsi, ahaṃ addasaṃ araññe pavane caramāno purāṇaṃ maggaṃ purāṇ'añjasaṃ pubbakehi manussehi anuyātaṃ tamanugacchiṃ.

4379.meaning2: favours, treats with kindness; protects, helps; acknowledges, admits

examples.text: s'āyaṃ nhānīyapiṇḍi sneha-anugatā snehaparetā santarabāhirā phuṭā snehena na ca pagghariṇī
kāy'anvayaṃ hotī'ti kāya-anugataṃ hoti kāyassa vasavatti.

4383.synonym: aṭṭa, avatiṇṇa, dukkhita, dukhita, phuṭṭha, sabyābajjha

4384.grammar: fem, abstr, in comps, from anugacchati
4384.meaning1: following after; adhering to; agreement with; conforming to

examples.text: kiñ'c'āpi, bhikkhave, evarūpassa puggalassa na diṭṭhi-anugatiṃ āpajjati, atha kho naṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggacchati, kalyāṇamitto purisapuggalo kalyāṇasahāyo kalyāṇasampavaṅko'ti.

4394.commentary: (MNa) tadanugāyantī'ti eta'r'ahi brāhmaṇā taṃ tehi pubbe gītaṃ anugāyanti anusajjhāyanti vādenti.

examples.text: kiṃ pana, bhāradvāja, ye'pi te brāhmaṇānaṃ pubbakā isayo mantānaṃ kattāro mantānaṃ pavattāro yesam'idaṃ eta'r'ahi brāhmaṇā porāṇaṃ mantapadaṃ gītaṃ pavuttaṃ samihitaṃ tadanugāyanti tadanubhāsanti bhāsitam'anubhāsanti vācitam'anuvācenti

4397.commentary: (NIDD1) anugijjhatī'ti kilesakāmena vatthukāmesu gijjhati anugijjhati paligijjhati palibajjhatī'ti, yo naro anugijjhati.

examples.text: khettaṃ vatthuṃ hiraññaṃ vā, gav'assaṃ dāsaporisaṃ, thiyo bandhū puthu kāme, yo naro anugijjhati.

4399.synonym: aṭṭhiya, atthika, atthiya, apekkha, abhijjhāyanta, iccha, icchaka, icchanta, icchamāna, kāmayamāna, kāmayāna, kāmī, jappanta, jigiṃsanta

examples.text: lūkhena'pi vā santusse, n'āññaṃ patthe rasaṃ bahuṃ, rasesu anugiddhassa, jhāne na ramatī mano.
